g.text: 5V regulated centre-positive barrel only. Q1 protects reverse polarity, NOT overvoltage.

g.desc: 5V regulated centre-positive barrel only. Q1 protects reverse polarity, NOT overvoltage.

g.text: J9 USB-B to J10 internal USB-A and Adafruit898 A/micro-B jumper to Pico. USB_VBUS NOT tied to V5.

g.desc: J9 USB-B to J10 internal USB-A and Adafruit898 A/micro-B jumper to Pico. USB_VBUS NOT tied to V5.

g.text: Core J4 pins2 and7 NC. Core power uses separate 5V Berg cable;12V position NC.

g.desc: Core J4 pins2 and7 NC. Core power uses separate 5V Berg cable;12V position NC.

g.text: Accessory is custom3V3 SPI only, not UEXT/RS232/5V bus. Active Next adapter pending.

g.desc: Accessory is custom3V3 SPI only, not UEXT/RS232/5V bus. Active Next adapter pending.

g.text: J1 Switchcraft mapping: 1=SRQ,2=CLK,3=GND,4=DATA,5=ATN,6=RESET. Pin-map study: passive symbols; ERC is not electrical validation. Routing, ESD, host power-off and firmware pending. 2A input fuse, 0.2A maximum LED allocation.

g.desc: J1 Switchcraft mapping: 1=SRQ,2=CLK,3=GND,4=DATA,5=ATN,6=RESET. Pin-map study: passive symbols; ERC is not electrical validation. Routing, ESD, host power-off and firmware pending. 2A input fuse, 0.2A maximum LED allocation.
